headline: Qlik Sense servers hit with reverse shells; Credit Mutuel Arkea reports €100m missing; OpenSSH SSHole due 11-12, Barracuda ESG due 11-13

bullets.text: New: attackers are targeting Qlik Sense servers with reverse shells and staging ActiveMQ and Veeam exploits (The Hacker News). Separately, AntiFox AI agents are being used in AWS credential-theft attacks (BleepingComputer).

New: French bank Credit Mutuel Arkea says €100m is missing after a cyberattack. Wyndham exposed customer data through an app security lapse; Fullerton Health in Singapore and hundreds of Dutch sports clubs also reported breaches.

New: Git fixed six vulnerabilities, including code execution during recursive clones (Help Net Security). Earlier today Citrix and Ivanti patched critical and high-severity flaws, and Asus and Zoom shipped security patches.
Due tomorrow, 11-12: OpenSSH SSHole CVE-2026-123158 (exploited to breach Linux systems, 4 outlets), GPUStack CVE-2026-102895, FreeSwitch CVE-2026-116779 and IBM Aspera Faspex CVE-2026-123218.

Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 (auth bypass) and CVE-2026-111560 (OS command injection) are exploited (4 outlets); KEV due 11-13, as is Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 and Openwave Webtop CVE-2026-111793 are due 11-24.

Still active: N-able released hotfixes for the published N-central zero-days (4 outlets); Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); Maersk probing data theft; Poland's ePUAP shut down. The week ran 1.15x the 90-day average.

actions: Check internet-facing Qlik Sense servers for reverse shells and unexpected processes; make sure ActiveMQ and Veeam hosts are patched.
Update Git on developer machines and CI runners, and avoid recursive clones of untrusted repositories until updated.
Patch OpenSSH (CVE-2026-123158), GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex today; their KEV deadline is 11-12.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (due 11-13) and hunt for compromise; patch Citrix and Ivanti Connect Secure.
N-central customers: apply the hotfixes. Patch Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave Webtop, Outlook (CVE-2026-124194) and Chrome before 11-24.
Review AWS access keys and CloudTrail for unusual use, and rotate any credentials that may be exposed.
